observed_original_failure.failure_observation_source: Original job failure supplied by root; this review independently reads source, not the full historical job log.

source_diagnosis: The test_stdio_server declares thread_hint with ui.visibility=[] and demands threadId in request metadata before returning two fixed text content blocks.

CoreHookMcpExecutor constructs the correct owning threadId but first calls McpBinding::prepare_call. That API expressly filters out tools for which tool_is_model_visible is false. The hidden thread_hint is therefore rejected before its transport call.

The failed hook result becomes an error entry, with no additional_contexts_for_model. HookAdditionalContext would otherwise preserve the complete joined text as a developer message. This source path explains the original missing exact context without changing its expected text.

capture_binding_with_metadata already filters each ready server's tools with the configured tool_filter and captures an exact client, catalog revision and timeout. It retains permitted hidden entries in calls while separately omitting them from tools.

change_scope.production: Add a dedicated prepare_call_for_hook lookup in the same frozen permitted calls map; use it only in CoreHookMcpExecutor.

validation.required_native: Run the current original hooks_mcp integration cases including hidden-context and both governed transport guards, plus the complete codex-mcp binding test module under the exact adopted source; retain the original budgets and assertions.

boundaries: Configured, trusted hook execution already has an explicit policy path distinct from model tool visibility; this change does not make hidden tools model-callable.
The new lookup does not consult raw client tools or reconnect/reroute to a latest runtime; an absent call remains denied and catalog replacement is still rejected before preparation.
